race.title: Activ8 Solar Energies Irish EBF Mares Handicap Chase
race.verdict: KARAMOJA caught the eye off this mark in the spring and, given time to get over her fall at Punchestown in May, is taken to double her tally in this sphere. Karia Des Blaises is likely to prove the main danger if avoiding mistakes, with The Great Nudie respected after shaping much better than the result on return. Break My Soul arrives on the back of a poor effort but is one to note if strong in the market. KARAMOJA (FR) KARIA DES BLAISES (FR) THE GREAT NUDIE (IRE)
